#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int n, bitCoins;
    std::cin >> n >> bitCoins;
    std::vector<int> values(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> values[i];
    }

    int odd = 0, even = 0;
    std::vector<int> costs;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (values[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (odd == even) {
            costs.push_back(std::abs(values[i + 1] - values[i]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int remaining = bitCoins;
    int count = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (cost <= remaining) {
            remaining -= cost;
            ++count;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
